agent_explanation: At step 59 body 0 is free, controller_force is exactly at fmax (59.983). At step 60 body 0 collides with body 1 (touching_pairs gap ~0.0003). In that same step controller_force jumps to 163.22 > fmax 59.983. The collision impulse/velocity change occurs within substeps (15 substeps) and the controller's proportional law produces a large force that is not clamped to fmax during/after collision resolution. Raising fmax to 200 eliminates the violation, confirming force limiting is bypassed during collisions.
